GET /rest/basket/:id looks up BasketModel by attacker-supplied req.params.id with no binding to the authenticated user (appendUserId sets body.UserId, unused here). Any authenticated user can read any user's basket contents; the basketAccessChallenge even solves when user.bid != id.

addBasketItem's attempted authorization check validates only basketIds[0] against user.bid, but the item is created under basketIds[basketIds.length-1] (line 42). A request with duplicate BasketId keys (e.g. [own, victim]) passes the check and inserts a product into another user's basket (basketManipulateChallenge).
